tooling_note: Visual council simulated as named reviewers due to sub-agent tool policy.

agents.recommendation: Use coffee, list, chair, pastry, dishes, laundry, and market objects only as evidence of partnership, never as standalone still lifes.
Block each slide around one action and one reaction: noticing, making room, choosing the second, drying badly, tossing the sock, forgetting the list.
Vary location and camera distance while preserving the same identity bundle, warm ivory paper, and tactile casual wardrobe anchors.

options.name: Ritual Evidence Montage
options.case_for: Most ownable, varied, and generative. It turns the reference into a staged Aachu/Zuv story.
options.risk: Continuity must be maintained across ten slides.

options.name: One Evening At Home
options.risk: Too many slides would repeat kitchen/home interiors and feel visually flat.

options.name: Mostly Object Vignettes
options.case_for: Elegant and close to the inspiration.
options.risk: Fails Stage-Scene Gate because text would carry the carousel.

selector_verdict: Use a varied ritual montage with Aachu/Zuv action in every slide. Start with a promise, move through daily proofs, use kitchen dancing as the romantic center, then end with all the boring parts becoming home.
rejected_visual_patterns: copying any supplied screenshot composition exactly
empty object still life with no couple action
same kitchen angle across multiple slides
